```{=html}

<script src="./svg-to-pdf.js"> </script>

<div id="svg-to-pdf-converter">
    <div class="upload-container" id="drop-zone">
        <label for="svgFile" class="drop-area">
            <div id="icon-svg-file">
                <i class="bi bi-filetype-svg"></i>
            </div>
            <p class="main-text">Click to upload or drag and drop</p>
            <p class="sub-text">SVG file only</p>
            <input type="file" id="svgFile" accept=".svg">
        </label>
    </div>
    
    <div id="file-info" class="hidden">
        <span id="file-name"></span>
        <button onclick="convertToPDF()" class="convert-btn">Convert to PDF</button>
    </div>
</div>


<script>
  const dropZone = document.getElementById('drop-zone');
  const fileInput = document.getElementById('svgFile');
  const fileInfo = document.getElementById('file-info');
  const fileNameDisplay = document.getElementById('file-name');

  // Highlight drop zone when item is dragged over it
  ['dragenter', 'dragover'].forEach(eventName => {
      dropZone.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          dropZone.firstElementChild.classList.add('drag-over');
      }, false);
  });

  // Remove highlight when item is dragged away
  ['dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
      dropZone.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          dropZone.firstElementChild.classList.remove('drag-over');
      }, false);
  });

  // Handle dropped files
  dropZone.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
      const files = e.dataTransfer.files;
      if (files.length) {
          fileInput.files = files; // Sync the dropped file to the hidden input
          updateFileInfo(files[0].name);
      }
  });

  // Handle click-to-upload files
  fileInput.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
      if (fileInput.files.length) {
          updateFileInfo(fileInput.files[0].name);
      }
  });
</script>

```
